description: Latest National Bank of Romania (BNR) official FX reference rates, parsed from BNR's daily XML feed. Returns the reference date plus an array of currency rates. Each rate is RON (Romanian leu) per `multiplier` units of the currency (multiplier is 1 unless noted, e.g. 100 for HUF/JPY/KRW), so the per-1-unit rate = value / multiplier. Currencies are ISO 4217 codes (plus XAU gold, XDR SDR).
name: bnr_exchange_rates
title: Bnr Exchange Rates
